descriptions.cc42b_coalesce_spans_8020f778: Scans each span except the unsigned count-minus-one limit for the first other span whose start equals its wrapped 32-bit end, extends its length, and removes that other span through the original swap-with-last helper. Preserves one merge per outer iteration and live count reload after removal; no extra validation, repeat-until-stable behavior or data ownership. Partial observed fixed-array pool view; complete class identity and size unknown.
